dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, this... Well, you know how the young people in Mondstadt all wish to join the Knights of Favonius, with their shining armor, their flying banners, the glory, and Master Jean as well...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: As for the Adventurers' Guild, the only impression of us people have is that of people who bumble about outdoors... Basically, no one cares about us.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I thought to myself that if there was an opportunity to show the Guild's mettle, we might be able to bring in more fresh blood.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, but it doesn't matter. The safety of Mondstadt is more important than my own personal wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I'll leave those monsters to you. I'll have your compensation ready.
